brief: Reduce the permissible load on Kingsley Green 138/13kV (SUB-SGW-699) in accordance with the ambient de-rating and sustained event requirements in MG-021 and MG-025, since the unit has accumulated heat above 30 degrees and sustained heavy load during the heat event. Consider emergency load transfer pursuant to ERP-032 if the unit approaches its temperature limit, ensuring the receiving asset's capacity is assessed with MG-021 de-ratings applied. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period as specified in MG-021.
